tip.control: a locked mode button in LOADOUT.CFG's program panel
tip.text: Locked until you draft the config augment that unlocks this mode. Owning it is not enough either: switch to it here before a dive.

claims.resolves: AUGMENTS lists each config (cfgArmHalt, cfgArmSiphon, cfgLock, cfgWard) that unlocks its matching ATTACK or DEFEND mode; owning one does not switch the kit to it, LOADOUT.CFG's mode buttons still gate the switch.
